purpose: Structured Tor reads of public forum discussions; source claims and identities remain unverified.

sources.assessment: Public MyBB thread bodies include access-sale claims and company-key demand. External marketplace origins may require login. Dates without explicit timezone/epoch remain raw; source dates do not establish collection lead time. No access, key validity or victim attribution is verified.

Public Portuguese-language Question2Answer discussions expose questions and answers with explicit timestamps. General marketplace noise is excluded from configured sections. Access requests are unverified, may concern sharing or study, and do not establish attack intent, compromise or detection lead time.

verification.method: Real stdio MCP reads over Tor, section continuation after restart, exact evidence replay, local context reconstruction and direct refresh.
verification.raw_receipts: Private; no raw post bodies or contact details are bundled.

verification.method: Real stdio MCP client over Tor, then server restart, cursor continuation, evidence replay and direct refresh.
verification.raw_receipts: Retained privately outside version control; no raw post bodies are bundled.
